changelog:
- Initial release of Agent Reflection Engine.
- Enables AI agents to self-audit decision traces and identify reasoning bottlenecks.
- Generates improvement patches using chain-of-thought critique.
- Designed for easy integration into agent loops via trace logging and periodic reflection.
- Lightweight and pluggable for developer use.
summary: Enables AI agents to self-audit decision steps, identify reasoning bottlenecks, and generate improvement patches via chain-of-thought critique.
